company.name: OpenGov
company.shortDescription: OpenGov is a digital cloud software provider that helps local governments and state agencies run government operations.
company.description: OpenGov is a provider of modern cloud software that enables government operations for local governments and state agencies. The company's software is designed specifically for the public sector's particular budgeting, procurement, and community development requirements.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based government operations platform that connects finance, permitting, public works, procurement, budgeting, revenue, and resident services across departments.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov Public Service Platform

productsAndServices.description: A government-focused enterprise resource planning system that connects financial management, budgeting, procurement, payroll, billing, revenue, grants, and other administrative operations.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov ERP

productsAndServices.description: A public-sector asset management system for tracking infrastructure, managing work orders, planning maintenance, and evaluating asset condition and lifecycle costs.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov Enterprise Asset Management

productsAndServices.description: A government permitting and licensing system for processing building permits, business licenses, inspections, zoning matters, right-of-way permits, and code enforcement cases.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov Permitting & Licensing

productsAndServices.description: A government financial management system covering general ledger, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, requisitions, bank reconciliation, and fixed assets.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov Financial Management

productsAndServices.description: A collaborative government budgeting and performance management system for operating budgets, workforce planning, capital planning, performance reporting, and online budget publication.
productsAndServices.name: OpenGov Budgeting & Performance

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $50,000,000, or 28.09% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,283,601 to $920,165,439, a 69.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 48 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
